title: Junior Data Analyst
description:

Experience in managing a pricing database and working with procurement and sales teams.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Join us on our mission to make a better world of work. Culture Amp is the world’s leading employee experience platform, revolutionizing how 25 million employees across more than 6,500 companies create a better world of work. Culture Amp empowers companies of all sizes and industries to transform employee engagement, drive performance management, and develop high-performing teams. Powered by people science and the most comprehensive employee dataset in the world, the most innovative companies including Canva, On, Asana, Dolby, McDonalds and Nasdaq depend on Culture Amp every day.
Culture Amp is backed by leading venture capital funds and has offices in the US, UK, Germany and Australia. Culture Amp has been recognized as one of the world’s top private cloud companies by Forbes and most innovative companies by Fast Company.
For more information visit cultureamp.com.
About The Role
Culture Amp's benchmark dataset is one of the largest and most comprehensive collections of employee engagement data in the world. It's central to how our customers understand whether their engagement scores are strong or need attention, and it's a key reason companies choose Culture Amp.
We're looking for a Data Analyst to join our Data Products team and become the go-to expert on this dataset. You'll connect directly with our customer-facing teams (sales, customer success, and people science) to answer questions about our benchmarks, support deals, and help customers get the most from their data. This is a role with two sides: you'll spend time responding to requests and performing ad-hoc analyses, both for benchmarks and our other curated data models. But you'll also have the opportunity to reduce that reactive load over time by building better self-serve tools, improving documentation, and automating repetitive work. You'll work closely with the data scientists who build and maintain our benchmark pipelines. There's genuine opportunity here to grow — whether that's into more senior analytics work or picking up aspects of the data science side if that interests you.
What you'll do
Field benchmark requests from customer-facing teams, translating business questions into data answers.
Investigate coverage, methodology, and metadata questions across our benchmark datasets.
Support custom benchmark creation for strategic deals.
Build and improve Looker dashboards and self-serve tooling so teams can answer more questions themselves.
Document tribal knowledge and make our benchmark data more accessible across the company.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Scientist
Location: Sydney
Employment Type: Contract
Overview
We are seeking a Senior Data Scientist to take ownership of the reliability and management of production data science systems. This role focuses on problem solving, managing production incidents, prioritising and managing deployments, and strengthening coding standards across the data science team.
This is a senior individual contributor role and you will work closely with the Principal Data Scientist, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and coordinate delivery partners to ensure production systems run reliably and improvements are delivered effectively.
What You'll Do

Production Management: Investigate and resolve issues impacting production systems, including reviewing and troubleshooting Python errors and coordinating fixes with relevant teams.
Stakeholder Communication: Clearly communicate issues, root causes, and resolution updates to technical teams and project stakeholders.
Production Updates & Deployments: Work with the Principal Data Scientist to prioritise updates and manage deployments to production systems.
Offshore Team Coordination: Manage and collaborate with offshore partners responsible for operational tasks, ensuring work is prioritised and delivered effectively.
Coding Standards & Engineering Practices: Collaborate with the Principal Data Scientist to elevate coding standards across the team. Implement and enforce best practices such as pre-commit hooks, automated testing, and code quality checks. Guide the broader team to adopt these standards in new development and align existing production code where appropriate.
Engineering Improvements: Encourage adoption of engineering best practices in new development and help align existing production code with improved standards where appropriate.
ML & LLM Systems Oversight: Support the stability and performance of machine learning models and Large Language Model (LLM) solutions deployed in production environments.
Stakeholder Communication: Clearly communicate technical issues, root causes, and resolutions to internal teams and project stakeholders.

What We're Looking For
Essential
5+ years of experience in data science or a closely related field.
Solid experience with NLP and large language models (LLMs) — including fine-tuning, working with APIs, prompt design, or deploying LLM-powered systems into production.
Strong Python skills, with confidence diagnosing and troubleshooting issues in production environments.
Solid experience working with Databricks for building and managing production data pipelines and ML workflows.
Proven track record of owning or managing live ML systems, with an understanding of what it takes to keep them stable.
Clear, thoughtful communication skills, able to translate technical details for both technical peers and non-technical stakeholders.
Experience collaborating across teams to solve complex problems with strong interpersonal skills.
A genuine commitment to code quality, with practical experience implementing coding standards, best practices, and tooling that stick.
A degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline.
Desirable
Experience in MLOps or a role bridging data science and engineering.
Familiarity with deployment infrastructure — containers, orchestration, feature stores, or similar.
Experience mentoring or guiding other data scientists.
Background in or strong working knowledge of data engineering principles and practices.

Why This Role Matters
This is an opportunity to take full ownership of production data science, ML, and LLM systems, while shaping engineering and coding standards across the data science team. The role offers a chance to make a tangible impact on the reliability, performance, and scalability of production systems.
Working closely with experienced leaders, you will drive improvements across the codebase and play a key role in advancing the organization’s data science operations.
The ideal candidate is hands-on, proactive, and passionate about data science, with a strong commitment to quality, innovation, and delivering results in production environments.
How to Apply
This is an immediate opportunity. If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply now and don’t miss this unique chance to take ownership of production data science, ML, and LLM systems.

Clear technical communication and cross-team alignment, enabling predictable delivery and informed decision-making

Ship High-Impact ML/RL Systems
Deliver production-grade ML/RL systems that create measurable improvements in quality, latency, cost, or reliability.
Replace or augment baseline approaches with small, domain-specific models where they provide superior performance-to-cost trade-offs.
Define and track clear success metrics and benchmarks for all deployed systems.

Maintain benchmark suites covering quality, latency, throughput, memory, and cost.
Drive explicit, data-backed trade-offs in model and deployment decisions.

Introduce reward-guided decoding or reranking with measurable gains.
Add monitoring, guardrails, and fallback strategies to manage instability and regressions.
Build Reliable Agentic Systems

Establish evaluation harnesses and regression tests to track agent reliability and cost over time.

Ensure training, experimentation, and deployment are reproducible, documented, and observable.
Partner closely with Product and Engineering to translate ambiguous problems into shippable ML/RL solutions.
Must-have experience

Applied ML in Production: ~5+ years building, training, and shipping ML systems using Python and PyTorch, with clear ownership beyond experimentation.

Agentic Systems: Experience building multi-step agents with orchestration concerns such as state, retries, timeouts, and fallbacks, and improving their reliability and cost in production.

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
About the Role
This is a varied role for for an exceptional and motivated BI/Data engineer who is able to go between BI and some Data Engineering work.
You will get to build a generational business from the ground up, work closely with proven founders and solve a problem that will meaningfully improve millions of lives.
We see the right person in this role building our BI function from scratch - everything from business reporting, to data pipelines and product analytics. We work with immense amounts of data across a variety of modalities including diagnostic radiology and pathology as well as our ecosystem of partners and operational business
As an example, here are some of the types of projects you might work on:
Build business reporting - define the right metrics and segments across the business. Build BAU reporting for teams and give them self-service tools to answer their own questions.
Build product and growth analytics - set up the infrastructure we need to answer business questions from across our product and growth tech stack.
Help train our AI models - we have custom ML models and LLMs we use for everything from clinical support systems to help doctors predict interventions and diagnoses to extract data from outdated documents and formats.
This is a full-time role, with 2-3 days per week in-office for team members located near our Sydney (Surry Hills) office.
Responsibilities and scope:
Proven BI engineer: 4+ years working as a BI engineer on a variety of problems that aren’t always engineering ones. This could be building pipelines, wrangling data or answering business questions.
Truth-seeking: you care about getting the right answers and understanding the nuances of the data you’re working with. You push others to find the “truth” and not the easiest answer and can quickly get to the 80/20 of questions with an answer.
Relentlessly resourceful: you aren’t afraid to get in the weeds and know when and how to move fast with limited resources while still thinking strategically. You can find 30 minute solutions to 30 day problems, anticipate and work around obstacles and deliver results in half the time most competent people think is possible.
Unreasonably high standards: you hold yourself and those around you to standards so high, some think they’re unreasonable. Whether it’s setting ambitious goals, delighting customer or scaling operations you understand that excellence means caring about the details and always raising the bar.
Incredible teammate: you communicate with kindness and enjoy the growth that comes from giving and receiving direct and honest feedback. You acknowledge your mistakes, know when to “disagree and commit” and care more about the team being successful than you being right.
Owner: you’re motivated by what’s best for our customers long term. That means being excited to work on the problems that matter most, never saying “that’s not my job”, being highly accountable for commitments you make and taking the initiative to find new ways to progress our mission.
Working at Everlab:
Do work that matters: We’re building the future of preventive health. Use your skills to prevent disease, improve access to personalised care, and reduce pressure on the health system.
Work-life flexibility: Hybrid working with 2 to 3 days in the office, plus flexibility to manage life beyond the 9 to 5 when it matters.
Experience Everlab as a customer: Full access to the Everlab health program, provided after successfully passing probation.
Share in our success: Employee Share Option Plan included as part of your total remuneration. We grow together.
People you’ll love working with: A welcoming, mission-driven team of smart, thoughtful people doing meaningful work.
Everlab is on a mission to build the future of preventive health — empowering people to take control of their wellbeing before problems arise.

Everlab is an early stage HealthTech startup that recently announced a $15m Seed stage round, building tech-enabled healthcare that improves and extends quality of life using cutting-edge medical research and technology. Our products design and coach our members through personalised risk-management and health-optimisation protocols over months and years to measurably improve lives.
Our founding team is experienced in the Medical industry including the preventative health specialist who founded Australia’s first full-body MRI clinic, to serial entrepreneurs that have scaled unicorns and have $500m+ in exits.
Our mission is to solve high-impact problems in healthcare that have never been tackled before, which isn’t easy. We look for people that are excited by this mission and the challenges they bring as our team is driven to solve these problems together.
Our team is hybrid with 2-3 days a week in office, within the CBD of the job's posted location.

title: Engineering Manager - WIQ
description:
Engineering Manager
Build and deploy production ML & Data systems at scale - Work with cutting-edge ML technologies (LLMs, GenAI, Agentic AI) on real-world problems impacting millions of customers across Australia and New Zealand
Shape the future of retail with AI - Pioneer innovative ML solutions that transform how 24 million customers shop, from personalised recommendations to intelligent supply chain optimisation
Grow your craft - Collaborate with world-class Data Scientists and Engineers in an agile environment that values experimentation, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning
About us
We strive to create better experiences together for a better tomorrow for our customers and team, bringing the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium together to make data driven decisions. By partnering with Quantium, a world-class data science and advanced analytics business we're excited about the future as we unlock the power of data to reimagine retail.
Through this partnership, we've created a new business called WiQ who will harness the best of Woolworths Group and Quantium to reimagine retail by solving the most complex problems using data and analytics. As a team, we leverage Agile ways of working to help our team develop their skills while also making sure our team is focusing on solving the most complex problems for both our customers and team.
What you'll do
This is a unique opportunity to be both a technical leader and a people manager, shaping the future of data and AI at the core of WiQ. As a Lead Engineer / Engineering Manager, you will lead a talented team of 3-5 engineers, guiding their careers while remaining a deeply hands-on technical expert responsible for building our next generation of data and machine learning platforms.
You will architect and build the foundational data platforms and the intelligent ML systems that run on them. This role is for a "technical gun" with a deep command of software fundamentals who can design for scale, lead a team, and own the end-to-end delivery of complex data and ML solutions. If you are driven to build remarkable, high-performance systems and empower a team to do the same, this is the role for you.
Team & Technical Leadership: Lead, manage, and mentor a team of 3-5 Data and Machine Learning engineers. Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, and continuous growth through rigorous code reviews, pair programming, and career development guidance.
Hands-On Development: Remain deeply hands-on, applying rock-solid software fundamentals to build robust data and ML pipelines, scalable APIs, and efficient data models. 
End-to-End Platform Ownership: Oversee the delivery of critical data and ML projects, ensuring timely completion while upholding high standards of quality, reliability, and performance. You will manage the team's roadmap, and ensure stakeholder expectations are met.
Drive Engineering & MLOps Excellence: Champion and implement best practices for both Data and ML engineering. This includes automated data quality frameworks, CI/CD for data and ML, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and advanced MLOps patterns (e.g., model monitoring, A/B testing, feature stores).
Strategic Contribution: Collaborate closely with Delivery Managers, Data Scientists, and senior leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
What you'll bring
We are looking for a seasoned engineering leader with a strong problem-solving mindset and a passion for building high-performance systems and high-performing teams, while meeting business requirements across the Woolworths’ ecosystem.
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience)
8+ years of commercial software development experience
5+ years of hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and Linux
Experience building data pipelines using cloud technologies such as Vertex AI Pipelines, Apache Airflow, DBT or similar orchestration tools
Practical experience with MLOps/DevOps practices, including model deployment, monitoring, and automation
Experience with containerisation technologies like Docker and Kubernetes
Knowledge of microservices-oriented architecture and REST APIs
Experience in CI/CD pipeline setup (shell scripting, Unit/Integration Testing)
Proven communication and stakeholder management skills
Hands-on experience with Google Cloud (GCP) or other major cloud providers (AWS, Azure) is beneficial
Demonstrated experience with modern ML algorithms (e.g., GNN, LLM, GenAI, Agentic AI) or a strong passion to learn new skills is advantageous
What you’ll experience
 Our Team Members are at the heart of everything we do and we’re always looking for ways to support your career journey and reward great work:
Team discounts across our range of Woolworths Group brands you know and love and a robust rewards program that celebrates and incentivises purpose-driven work.
A global business with endless career possibilities around every corner and across every discipline – with valuable exposure to a vast and exciting business network.
High impact role supporting our teams who enrich our communities. 
A range of programs to help you prioritise and manage your wellbeing, including 24/7 access to the Sonder app.
A progressive and competitive leave policy that gives you more space for what matters to you.
